name: RTX2080Ti
_notes: RTX 2080 Ti (TU102, Turing, sm75). HOST HARDWARE TRUTH (L9-consumer, 2026-06-10): the 2080ti host runs 8x 22GiB-modded cards — nvidia-smi memory.total = 22528 MiB on ALL 8 GPUs (= 23622320128 bytes; matches sweep.yaml hosts.2080ti.vram_gb_per_gpu: 22 and the orchestrator gpu-state snapshots), NOT the stock 11 GiB this file previously carried. The mod doubles GDDR6 density on the SAME 352-bit bus at 14 Gbps, so peak_bw stays the datasheet 616 GB/s. peak_flops = 53.8 TFLOPS dense FP16 tensor with FP32 accumulate — VERIFIED for the GT runs: the vLLM server logs show 'Casting torch.bfloat16 to torch.float16' + dtype=torch.float16 (sm75 has no bf16), and PyTorch/cuBLAS HGEMM uses FP32 accumulation (CUBLAS_COMPUTE_32F), which GeForce Turing runs at half the FP16-accumulate rate (107.6) per the NVIDIA Turing architecture whitepaper. util_*/scheduler_overhead remain H100 PLACEHOLDERS (NB: the H100 source values re-derive to 0.5886/0.8111/4.5574 under the pinned recipe, roofline_utils_H100.json; per-GPU measurement recipe: build_roofline_utils.py); no measured kernels.
